Item 2.02 Results of Operations and Financial Condition.

On May 1, 2025, the Company issued a press release announcing its financial results for the fiscal quarter ended March 29, 2025. A copy of the press release is attached hereto as Exhibit 99.1 and is incorporated herein by reference. The information in this Item 2.02 shall not be deemed filed for purposes of Section 18.

Item 5.02 Departure of Directors or Certain Officers.

On April 30, 2025, the Chief Financial Officer notified the Company of her intention to retire effective June 30, 2025. The Board has initiated a search for a successor and the retiring officer will assist with the transition through the effective date to ensure continuity of the finance organization.
